skill.name: bug-review
skill.criteria: Report only concrete, demonstrated harm. Ignore style preferences unless they cause a defect.

finding.title: Off-by-one in increment
finding.body: callers expect increment(0) to return 0, but the function returns 1, so zero-based counters start at one.

supported.instructions: Does the presented HEAD code and evidence in `range` and `evidence` support the claim in `finding`?

criteria.true: The quoted code shows the claimed behavior without further inference.
criteria.false: The quoted code contradicts the claim, or the claim needs code that is not presented.

commentWorthy.instructions: According to `skill.criteria`, does `finding` describe a concrete harm that warrants an inline review comment?

criteria.true: A concrete defect or harm with a real trigger and impact.
criteria.false: A style preference, speculation, or harmlessness.

rangeQuality.instructions: Does `range` contain exactly the code lines needed to support `finding`?

criteria.too_narrow: The range omits lines the finding depends on.
criteria.too_wide: The range includes unrelated lines beyond what the finding needs.
criteria.wrong_location: The range points at code unrelated to the finding.
